bitstream.issue: uint8_t position wraps at 255, causing re-reads from start
bitstream.fix: Position trait: usize (safe, no wrap) vs u8 (ABI, wrapping_add)
bitstream.hint: Emit Reader<P: Position>. Safe path stops at end; ABI wraps.

dstr.issue: Empty find string causes infinite loop; capacity overflow possible
dstr.fix: Safe replace: empty needle is no-op; grow carefully or use Vec
dstr.hint: Use Dstr with checked operations. Differential vs C ABI.

utf8.fix: Walk back to valid UTF-8 boundary
utf8.hint: Use truncate_utf8 / truncate_filename. Never split codepoints.

path_extension.issue: NULL or empty path may dereference
path_extension.fix: Return None for null/empty; find last . after last separator

null_safety.issue: Many C helpers crash or UB on NULL
null_safety.fix: Safe path returns None/empty/false; ABI preserves original
null_safety.hint: Prefer Option and early returns. Test both paths.

calldata.issue: Get must require both key present and exact type; Ptr was missing; empty names accepted; null string was not distinct
calldata.fix: Result with MissingKey vs TypeMismatch vs NullString; CallValue::Ptr and StrNull; reject empty names
calldata.hint: Emit set_int/float/bool/str/ptr/str_null and get_* that return Result. Never unwrap on missing or wrong type.

decl.issue: Declaration strings are free-form; unknown types and duplicate names must be rejected
decl.fix: parse_decl returns DeclInfo or DeclError; reserved names rejected; default flag is in
decl.hint: Use parse_decl. Wire via SignalHandler::add_decl / ProcHandler::add_decl.

signal.issue: Unknown signals and empty names must be no-ops; globals receive every declared signal
signal.fix: HashMap of DeclInfo + listeners; add_decl parses; disconnect and remove; connect_global
signal.hint: Emit add_decl, connect, disconnect, signal_with_globals. Unknown signal does not notify globals.

obs_data.issue: Missing keys and type mismatches must fail distinctly; nested objects and arrays needed; JSON must round-trip
obs_data.fix: ObsData with defaults, Object, Array, to_json/from_json, apply. Empty names rejected.
obs_data.hint: Use set_*/get_* Result API. apply overwrites; defaults fill missing keys.

obs_properties.issue: Duplicate and empty names must be rejected; list options must round-trip
obs_properties.fix: Properties Vec with Bool/Int/Float/Text/List. add_* returns Result.
obs_properties.hint: Emit add_bool/int/float/text/list. Reject EmptyName and Duplicate.

source_context.issue: Empty names must be rejected; settings, properties, signal, and proc must be owned together
source_context.fix: SourceContext owns name + ObsData + Properties + SignalHandler + ProcHandler
source_context.hint: Use SourceContext::new. settings_mut and signals_mut for writes.
